defs.def: a piece of equipment for taking photographs, moving pictures or television pictures 照相机；（电影）摄影机；（电视）摄像机

ex.s: Bring along your camera and enjoy the wonderful views along this well-surfaced forest path.
ex.t: 带上相机，沿着这条铺设平整的森林小径欣赏美景吧。

ex.s: Once we found the place, it was stressful getting lights and cameras set up in the limited time.
ex.t: 一旦我们找到那个地方，在有限的时间里安装灯光和摄像头 压力很大。

ex.s: There's one notable gap in my new-media experience, however: I've spent little time in front of a camera, since I have a face made for radio.
ex.t: 然而，我在新媒体经验中有一个明显的空白：我很少出现在镜头前，因为我有一张适合做广播的脸。

ex.s: It will use cameras and sensors to monitor the animals.
ex.t: 它将使用摄像头和传感器来监测动物。

ex.s: When I'm face to face with a polar bear，I like it to be through a camera with a telephoto lens.
ex.t: 当我面对面遇到北极熊时，我喜欢通过带长焦镜头的相机来看它。

ex.s: Digital cameras arrived on the scene in 1997.
ex.t: 数码相机于1997年到达现场。

ex.s: If you don’t own a camera, you can buy one.
ex.t: 如果你没有相机，可以买一台。

ex.s: Slowly, and with the camera still held to my eye, I turned… and froze.
ex.t: 我慢慢地转过身，相机仍贴在眼前……然后僵住了。

ex.s: When I recovered from the shock, I looked at my camera.
ex.t: 当我从惊吓中回过神来，我看了看相机。

ex.s: Slowly, and with the camera still held to my eye, I turned...and froze.
ex.t: 我慢慢地转过身，相机仍贴在眼前……然后僵住了。

ex.s: While still holding the camera to my eye, I turned slowly...then stopped still.
ex.t: 仍把相机贴在眼前，我缓缓转过身……然后静止不动。

ex.s: Remember to bring your camera!
ex.t: 记得带上你的相机！
